name: Measurement, monitoring and verification (4D seismic, DAS, satellite InSAR)
principle: MMV tracks injected CO2 and checks containment: time-lapse (4D) seismic and VSP image the plume, fibre-optic DAS and DTS give continuous well data, InSAR measures ground displacement, and soil gas and groundwater sampling check the surface. Quest (Alberta) injects about 1 Mt/yr with a 27 Mt target and has recorded no microseismic event indicating loss of containment.

performance.basis: total target 27 Mt; MMV plan revised every 3 years

source.note: Lawton et al., CCUS monitoring, measurement and verification (Alberta Innovates)

limitations: The paper does not give detection thresholds or costs
